title: Data Centre: The Physical Infrastructure Behind AI (The Real Building)
content:
# Data Centre: The Physical Infrastructure

## The Quick Answer

A **data centre** is a building full of computers.

An **AI data centre** is a building full of thousands of GPUs.

**Cost to build:** $500M-$2B
**Power consumption:** 50-500 megawatts (city-scale)
**Annual operating cost:** $70-120M

Every API call happens in a physical building.

## Why This Matters

Someone had to:
- Build the building ($300M+)
- Buy GPUs ($500M+)
- Install cooling systems ($100M+)
- Pay for electricity ($50-100M/year)

That's why AI costs money.

## Inside an AI Data Centre

**What's in there:**
- Server racks (10,000+ GPUs)
- Cooling system (removes heat)
- Power distribution (50-500 megawatts)
- Networking (connects all servers)
- Security system (protects hardware and data)

## The Heat Problem

```
One NVIDIA A100 GPU: 400 watts of heat
1000 GPUs: 400 kilowatts of heat
Equivalent to: 400 residential homes generating heat
Must be removed: Continuously or hardware fails

Solution: Liquid cooling system
Cost: 30-50% of data centre's total power bill
```

## Power Infrastructure

```
500 megawatt data centre:
- Equivalent to: 400,000 homes
- Annual cost: $50-100 million
- Backup: Diesel generators (hours of power)
- UPS: Battery backup (seconds of power)

If power fails:
- UPS keeps systems running (~30 seconds)
- Generators start automatically (~10 seconds)
- No interruption to users
```

## Geographic Distribution

Mistral has data centres in:
- **US:** California, Virginia, multiple locations
- **Europe:** France, Netherlands, multiple locations
- **Asia:** Singapore, Japan

**Why multiple locations:**
- Latency (route to nearest server)
- Redundancy (if one fails, others handle traffic)
- Regulations (data residency requirements)

## Cost Breakdown

| Item | Cost | Percentage |
|------|------|------------|
| Building/Land | $300M | 30% |
| Hardware (GPUs) | $500M | 50% |
| Power/Cooling | $100M | 10% |
| Security/Network | $50M | 5% |
| Staffing (annual) | $20M | 5% |

## Environmental Impact

**Data centre electricity globally:**
- 2-3% of world's electricity
- AI data centres: Growing 15-25% annually
- Trend: Unsustainable without renewable energy

**Carbon per request:**
```
One API call: ~0.1g CO2
1 million calls: 100kg CO2
1 billion calls: 100 metric tons CO2
```

## Why This Matters

Understanding data centres explains:
- Why AI costs money (infrastructure expensive)
- Why it's not free (electricity costs $50M+ per year)
- Why it's mainly available in rich countries (needs $1B+ investment)
- Why environmental concerns exist (massive power draw)
